result.summary: The image depicts a residential intersection with multi-family brick buildings and continuous sidewalks. While a marked crosswalk exists for the side street, the main thoroughfare lacks a designated crossing, exposing pedestrians to traffic across a wide roadway. The absence of traffic signals or speed control measures in this residential context presents a safety gap for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Lack of Main Road Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalk or pedestrian refuge is provided for crossing the wide main street.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: The excessive width of the roadway may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Parked cars near the intersection corner can block the view between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the curb

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a continental-style crosswalk across the main road to improve pedestrian visibility and priority.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions

interventions.description: Implement traffic calming features such as speed humps or raised crosswalks to reduce vehicle speeds.
